plate.title: B13 · Quiet interlocking serif bands
plate.description: The four actual quarter-related serif-I contours remain the dominant pattern and retain their exact colour-selection identities. The overall read adds only a centreline; the intermediate read has one slender bar-aligned leaf per chamber; the detail read has two opposed simple leaves meeting at the bar's centre. Bare caps and interlocks preserve the source rhythm without flowers, cap fans or nested collars.

constructionNotes: The four actual quarter-related serif-I contours remain the dominant pattern and retain their exact colour-selection identities. The overall read adds only a centreline; the intermediate read has one slender bar-aligned leaf per chamber; the detail read has two opposed simple leaves meeting at the bar's centre. Bare caps and interlocks preserve the source rhythm without flowers, cap fans or nested collars. Curved rendering rounds selected flowing contours only; pointed tips, roots and native source seam identities remain fixed. Four colour groups are exact disjoint path selections, not screen-location bins.
